title: Negated query check
statement: Given a sign query check and a choice of predicate input positions to negate, form a new check using the predicate with those inputs negated. At each selected position, negate the corresponding queried sign vector; at every other position, keep the original query.
hypotheses_covered: A sign query check on the Boolean cube of dimension n
